in_sanskrit.name: देवव्रत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who loves and worships the gods.

in_hindi.name: देवव्रत
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (deva) के लिए व्रत (vrat) करनेवाला (one who performs vrat for the god)

in_tamil.name: தேவவிரத
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவம் (god) அவர்களின் விரதம் (vow) காலம் பார்க்கிற இந்த பெப்பில் (This person keeps the vow of the god)

in_telugu.name: దేశజ్జేశ్వరద్యేశ్యోదేశ
in_telugu.meaning: దేశ (dhesh, god) + జ్జేశ్ (jjesha, desire) + శ్యోదేశ్ (shyodisha, one who pleases)
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశ (god) చేదిపోయే (one who) జ్జేశ్ (desires) శ్యోదేశ్ (to please)

in_marathi.name: Devavrat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devavrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devavrat is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘Vrat’ meaning bound or pledged. This name signifies a person who is deeply devoted to the divine and is bound by the vows and promises made to the gods.
